headline: NextEra CEO Ketchum Discusses Dominion Deal During Q3 Call
summary: NextEra Energy CEO John Ketchum discussed the company's proposed merger with Dominion Energy during its third-quarter earnings call.
why: NextEra Energy and Dominion Energy are major US electric utilities; consolidation in the sector directly affects energy infrastructure and power generation assets.

impacts.name: Dominion Energy
impacts.why: Merger discussions outline regulatory and strategic paths toward uniting two large power companies.
